jordan.name: The Jordan River
jordan.summary: The green river valley where John baptized the crowds. Jesus was baptized here, and here John called Him the Lamb of God. John 1:28 calls the place Bethany beyond the Jordan.

wilderness.name: The Wilderness
wilderness.summary: A dry, rocky land of stones and heat. The Spirit led Jesus here, where He fasted forty days and answered every temptation with Scripture.

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem
jerusalem.summary: The holy city, with God's temple on its hill. The devil set Jesus on the pinnacle of the temple, but Jesus would not test God.

galilee.name: Galilee
galilee.summary: The green hill country in the north, around the Sea of Galilee. Jesus said to Philip, “Follow Me,” and Nathanael met Jesus.

bethsaida.name: Bethsaida
bethsaida.summary: A fishing town on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee. Home of Philip, Andrew and Peter.

capernaum.name: Capernaum
capernaum.summary: A fishing town on the Sea of Galilee.

nazareth.name: Nazareth
nazareth.summary: The small hill town where Jesus grew up.

cana.name: Cana
cana.summary: A village in Galilee, Nathanael's hometown.

bethlehem.name: Bethlehem
bethlehem.summary: The town where Jesus was born.

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.summary: An old city of palm trees near the Jordan River.
